[RDSC.5.8.6] **Round-trip test obligation.** The
conforming-compiler test suite must include a fixture
that loads a `.dsc` and verifies the [RDSC.5.8.5]
invariant mechanically: for every schema whose `SchemaDef`
carries a `proto_source`, parse it, walk its message fields,
and assert that the field set agrees one-for-one with
the `Slot` atoms (slot count; each field's type against the type
[RDSC.5.8.7] gives its `Slot` atom's kind; and the `nullable` flag against
the field's `optional`, [RDSC.5.8.3]). A fact-reference slot's `schema_ref`
has no `.proto` side, since its field is `uint64` ([RDSC.5.8.3]), so the
comparison does not reach it.
Lifecycle and hydration are not compared: the `.proto` describes
slots only ([RDSC.5.8.5]).
The fixture must cover every slot kind in the
[RDSC.5.5] enum (`SLOT_KIND_INT`, `_FLOAT`, `_STRING`,
`_BOOL`, `_JSON`, `_SCHEMA`, `_BYTES`, `_TIME`, `_DATE`,
`_DURATION`) and both lifecycles
(LOGICAL and TTL), and a nullable slot of every kind that
admits one ([LNUL.3.1]). Failure of any unidirectional case
(`Slot` atom without matching `.proto` field, or
`.proto` field without matching `Slot` atom) is a
compiler bug per [RDSC.5.8.5]. Language-side
counterpart at [LFAC.8.6].
